queries.question: List the first 10 customers by customer_id.
queries.golden_sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name FROM customers ORDER BY customer_id LIMIT 10;

queries.question: What is the email address of customer 1?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT email FROM customers WHERE customer_id = 1;

queries.question: How many products are in the catalog?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products;

queries.question: List all product categories.
queries.golden_sql: SELECT category_id, category_name FROM categories;

queries.question: What is the unit price of the most expensive product?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT MAX(unit_price) AS max_price FROM products;

queries.question: How many orders have status 'cancelled'?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled';

queries.question: How many customers signed up in 2025?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2025-01-01' AND signup_date < '2026-01-01';

queries.question: What countries are customers from?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT country FROM customers;

queries.question: What are the top 5 best-selling products by quantity?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 5;

queries.question: List customers from Germany who placed an order in the last 90 days.
queries.golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT cu.customer_id, cu.first_name, cu.last_name FROM customers cu JOIN orders o ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE cu.country = 'DE' AND o.order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days';

queries.question: What is the average rating per product category?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT c.category_name, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON r.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY avg_rating DESC;

queries.question: Which customers have never placed an order?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT cu.customer_id, cu.first_name, cu.last_name FROM customers cu LEFT JOIN orders o ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL;

queries.question: List each order along with the customer's full name and country.
queries.golden_sql: SELECT o.order_id, cu.first_name, cu.last_name, cu.country FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON o.customer_id = cu.customer_id LIMIT 100;

queries.question: What is the product name and category for each item in order 1?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT p.product_name, c.category_name FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE oi.order_id = 1;

queries.question: Which products have an average rating below 3?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT p.product_name, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON r.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name HAVING AVG(r.rating) < 3;

queries.question: List customers along with how many orders each has placed.
queries.golden_sql: SELECT cu.customer_id, cu.first_name, cu.last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers cu LEFT JOIN orders o ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY cu.customer_id, cu.first_name, cu.last_name ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 20;

queries.question: Which category has the highest number of products?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT 1;

queries.question: List reviews left by customers who are from the US, along with the product name.
queries.golden_sql: SELECT r.review_id, p.product_name, r.rating FROM reviews r JOIN customers cu ON r.customer_id = cu.customer_id JOIN products p ON r.product_id = p.product_id WHERE cu.country = 'US' LIMIT 100;

queries.question: What is the net revenue by month for delivered orders?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount) AS net_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

queries.question: What is the average order value?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT AVG(order_total) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS order_total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id) t;

queries.question: How many orders were placed per status?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC;

queries.question: What is the total quantity sold per category?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT c.category_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC;

queries.question: What is the average product margin (unit price minus cost) by category?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT c.category_name, AVG(p.unit_price - p.cost) AS avg_margin FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY avg_margin DESC;

queries.question: How many distinct customers have left a 5-star review?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS five_star_reviewers FROM reviews WHERE rating = 5;

queries.question: What is the maximum number of items in a single order?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT MAX(item_count) AS max_items FROM (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) t;

queries.question: What percentage of orders are cancelled or refunded?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS pct_cancelled_or_refunded FROM orders;

queries.question: What is the total shipping cost collected per country?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT cu.country, SUM(o.shipping_cost) AS total_shipping FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON o.customer_id = cu.customer_id GROUP BY cu.country ORDER BY total_shipping DESC;

queries.question: How many reviews has each product received, top 10?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT p.product_name, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON r.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY review_count DESC LIMIT 10;

queries.question: How many orders were placed in the last 30 days?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS recent_orders FROM orders WHERE order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days';

queries.question: What orders were placed between 2024-01-01 and 2024-03-31?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-03-31' LIMIT 200;

queries.question: How many customers signed up before 2024?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pre_2024_signups FROM customers WHERE signup_date < '2024-01-01';

queries.question: What is the most recent review left for each product, top 10 products?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT product_id, MAX(review_date) AS latest_review FROM reviews GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY latest_review DESC LIMIT 10;

queries.question: How many orders were placed each year?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) AS year, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

queries.question: Which customers signed up in the last 90 days?
queries.golden_sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, signup_date FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days';
